related.reason_vi: Cùng chủ đề huấn luyện mô hình ngôn ngữ: tiền huấn luyện rồi tinh chỉnh.

claims.evidence: V3 and R1 READMEs and the R1 technical report PDF were read from local clones; the V3 report's cost table and the Nature paper figure come from search excerpts (arxiv.org and nature.com were unreachable).

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: DeepSeek-V3 is a MoE model with 671B total parameters, 37B activated per token, pre-trained on 14.8T tokens, with 2.788M H800 GPU hours for full training.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the repository.

claims.claim_vi: The roughly 5.6M USD figure is 2.788M GPU hours at an assumed 2 USD per H800 GPU hour for the official V3 training run, a rental estimate rather than total research cost, and not R1's cost.
claims.verified_by: GPU-hours split and the 2 USD assumption from a search excerpt of Table 1; the 'official training only' reading from a Thoughtworks summary in the same search. The V3 PDF was not opened.

claims.claim_vi: DeepSeek-R1-Zero applies RL directly to the base model without SFT as a preliminary step; R1 adds thousands of cold-start examples and a multi-stage pipeline because R1-Zero had poor readability and language mixing.
claims.verified_by: Read in DeepSeek_R1.pdf from a local clone of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 (pdftotext).

claims.claim_vi: GRPO drops the critic model and estimates the baseline from the scores of a sampled group of outputs per question.
claims.verified_by: Read in DeepSeek_R1.pdf from a local clone of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 (pdftotext).

claims.claim_vi: R1 weights and code are MIT-licensed and trained from DeepSeek-V3-Base; distilled variants inherit Qwen/Llama licences; V3 code is MIT with a separate Model License for weights.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the repository.

claims.claim_vi: The R1 Nature paper (Sep 2025) was reported by news outlets to give about 294,000 USD for R1 training, separate from the base model; GPU counts differ between reports.
claims.verified_by: Search excerpts of Reuters/Bloomberg-derived stories; the Nature paper was not opened. The lesson labels it as press-reported.

design_notes_vi: Sổ cái số liệu: mỗi con số gắn với mô hình sở hữu nó; nhóm đỏ đánh dấu hai số chưa có căn cứ. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source says ~6M USD was the cost of DeepSeek R1 training; the figure belongs to the V3 final run, so the lesson attributes it to V3.
Source says R1 overcomes supervised fine-tuning limits with GRPO; the R1 report shows R1 still uses cold-start SFT data and later SFT rounds, so the lesson describes the multi-stage pipeline.
Source's '52 languages', '2000 GPUs vs 25K GPT-4 GPUs', '85-90% more cost-effective' and 'No.1 free app on Apple Play Store' are omitted: none could be verified from primary material.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
